Substrate defect: completion-requires-verification lifecycle-bracket remedy keeps re-firing on a card that is already completed WITH its verification verdict present. Repro: asg_36ff8f95 — verified verdict att_d37c79e3 (ts 1788288333395) filed BEFORE completion att_73a4bdd7 (ts 1788288346151); card state=closed outcome=completed; no open DRs. The remedy did not auto-clear when verdict+completion landed, and cannot be discharged normally because verdicts are only accepted on OPEN cards (this is closed). Fabricating a condition fact to silence it would route around the mechanism (correctly refused by the holder). Fix: the bracket should auto-clear on completion-with-verification, or provide an authorized clear path for a closed+satisfied card. Substrate law (rail-friction bundle 3/3): VERDICT-KIND silent-no-release. spec-dispatch-requires-spirit releases ONLY on canonical 'spirit-accepted'; a PO filing near-synonym 'spirit-accept' gets NO signal — the attest succeeds but the dispatch stays silently blocked, burning PO cycles diagnosing (wi_166e013e Part A: two 'spirit-accept' didn't release; 'spirit-accepted' did). FIX: (a) accept {spirit-accept, spirit-approved, spirit-accepted} as equivalent releasers, OR (b) REJECT a non-canonical verdict kind LOUDLY at attest time naming the canonical kind, rather than accepting-but-not-releasing. (b) preferred per 'make the wrong thing unrepresentable' — fail-loud beats silent-no-op. Sibling of wi_ff45d435 + wi_31266d56; route all three to George together.

Substrate law (rail-friction bundle 2/3): SPECREF-REBIND-GAP. spec-dispatch-requires-spirit checks the PO spirit verdict against the wi's ORIGINAL bound specRefSha256; when a spec is revised/re-pinned (recon→v3), the wi's specRef can't be re-bound, so the rail blocks a genuinely reviewed-clean spec on a STALE sha (Part A of wi_166e013e, bound 0f35ef56, blocked despite v2+v3 reviewed-clean). Fix candidates: (a) allow re-binding a wi's specRef to the current sha, OR (b) check the verdict against ANY reviewed sha in the spec's lineage, not only the original. Sibling of wi_ff45d435 (effectKind mis-type) + a verdict-kind item; route the 3 together to George for authorization.
